name: Huandeng Zuiye
source:
An artificial Illuminator.

[spoiler]She driven by the commands of Genia in the base of Light Pollution.

She searchs for the meaning of life. Before she ever knew what she was born for, she was already determined to sacrifice her life for others.

The model used by Genia to create Fabrica was her older sister, Brita.[/spoiler]
